title: GEMglGenLists
description: generate a contiguous set of empty display lists

messages.description: number of contiguous empty display lists to be generated
first display list ID of the generated range

arguments.description: number of contiguous empty display lists to be generated

body: [GEMglGenLists] calls glGenLists() each time a gemlist passes through it, with the parameters set by its creation arguments and inlets. See glGenLists in the OpenGL reference.
